questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的 Ms、Mr 与 Hc 在外延薄膜、溶胶凝胶薄膜和介孔薄膜中为何相差数个数量级？

source_candidates.title: Epitaxial BiFeO3 Multiferroic Thin Film Heterostructures
source_candidates.independence_note: Original vibrating-sample magnetometry report for the widely cited thickness-dependent epitaxial-film magnetization.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Seventy to four-hundred nanometre epitaxial BiFeO3 films in the reported oxide heterostructure series
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature in-plane and out-of-plane vibrating-sample magnetometry with a thickness series
source_candidates.reported_lead: A 70 nm film is reported near 150 emu per cubic centimetre with coercive field near 200 Oe, while the 400 nm film is near 5 emu per cubic centimetre.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The substrate background, impurity debate, thickness and field geometry must remain attached; the 150 value is not a bulk BFO constant.

source_candidates.title: Enhanced Magnetic Properties of Co-Doped BiFeO3 Thin Films via Structural Progression
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent sol-gel film experiment includes a pristine BFO control measured in the same VSM series as the doped films.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Pristine polycrystalline BiFeO3 control film spin-coated on silicon and thermally treated with the reported sol-gel sequence
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature vibrating-sample magnetometry over zero to ten kilo-oersted with high-field background treatment described in the article
source_candidates.reported_lead: The pristine control is reported with Ms 21.38 and Mr 2.06 emu per cubic centimetre.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: A control embedded in a doping study is independently useful but not a reproduction of the 2003 epitaxial heterostructure.

source_candidates.title: Ferromagnetism in nanoscale BiFeO3
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent glycine-combustion nanoparticle series reports size-resolved room-temperature saturation moment in atom-normalized units.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Four nanoscale BiFeO3 powder conditions spanning about 4 to 40 nanometres, with minor impurity content reported below three percent
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature magnetic hysteresis over approximately plus or minus 1.5 tesla after size-setting heat treatments
source_candidates.reported_lead: Saturation moment decreases from 0.41 to 0.09 Bohr magneton per Fe as particle size increases from 4 to 40 nanometres, with intermediate values 0.27 and 0.13.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The four values are a heat-treatment and particle-size series from one study, not four independent synthesis batches; oxygen deficiency and minor impurities remain interpretation boundaries.

source_candidates.title: Mesoporous bismuth ferrite with amplified magnetoelectric coupling and electric field-induced ferrimagnetism
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent wet-chemical architecture and electric-field comparison exposes how porosity and field history alter the apparent saturation response.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Strained mesoporous BiFeO3 and analogous dense non-porous films
source_candidates.method_scope: Magnetization comparison before and after electric-field application with mesoporous and dense controls
source_candidates.reported_lead: Mesoporous films change from 0.04 to 0.84 Bohr magneton per Fe, whereas dense films change from 0.002 to 0.01 under the same field treatment.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Atom-normalized magnetic moment under an electric-field protocol cannot be pooled with volume magnetization without density and conversion evidence.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的吸收系数在不同波长、厚度、形貌与缺陷补偿下能否直接比较？

source_candidates.title: Influence of thickness on optical and structural properties of BiFeO3 thin films: PLD grown
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary paired-thickness PLD study with the same optical analysis route and substrate family.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Two-hundred and six-hundred nanometre BiFeO3 films deposited on ITO-coated glass
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature UV-visible absorption spectroscopy and thickness-resolved absorption-coefficient extraction
source_candidates.reported_lead: At 500 nm the reported absorption coefficients are 21111 and 48834 inverse centimetres for the 200 and 600 nm films, respectively.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The coefficient is wavelength- and thickness-bound; neither value is a wavelength-independent optical constant.

source_candidates.title: Femtosecond third-order optical nonlinearity of polycrystalline BiFeO3
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent radio-frequency sputtered film measured by transmittance and fitted with an envelope and Sellmeier-type method.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Polycrystalline BiFeO3 film on quartz with fitted thickness 510 plus or minus 23 nanometres
source_candidates.method_scope: Room-temperature optical transmittance with envelope analysis and Sellmeier-type dispersion fitting
source_candidates.reported_lead: At 780 nm the linear absorption coefficient is reported as 1.07 times ten to the fourth inverse centimetres.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The near-infrared fitted value is not directly comparable to the 500 nm PLD-film points without retaining wavelength and analysis method.

source_candidates.title: Prominent electrochromism through vacancy-order melting in a complex oxide
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent calcium-doped and oxygen-vacancy-compensated BFO comparison reports a wavelength-specific change rather than an absolute pristine-BFO coefficient.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Calcium-doped BiFeO3 with and without oxygen-vacancy compensation
source_candidates.method_scope: Measured optical-absorption change at 480 nm paired with first-principles absorption spectra
source_candidates.reported_lead: The measured absorption-coefficient change at 480 nm is reported as 4.8 million inverse metres between compensation states.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: A delta between doped defect states is not an absolute BFO absorption coefficient and must not be stored as one.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 的 Voc 与 Jsc 如何随电极、畴壁几何、极化方向、波长和光强改变？

source_candidates.title: Switchable ferroelectric diode and photovoltaic effects in polycrystalline BiFeO3 thin films grown on transparent substrates
source_candidates.independence_note: Primary vertically contacted polycrystalline-film experiment reports signed voltage and current density for opposite polarization states.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Au slash BiFeO3 slash ITO on quartz, polycrystalline PLD film
source_candidates.method_scope: Current-voltage curves under 375 nm continuous laser illumination at 630 milliwatts per square centimetre
source_candidates.reported_lead: Upward polarization gives about plus 0.17 V and minus 0.61 microampere per square centimetre; downward polarization gives minus 0.23 V and plus 57 microampere per square centimetre.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Signs depend on the authors' wiring convention and poling direction; the approximately hundredfold current asymmetry must not be averaged away.

source_candidates.title: Switchable Ferroelectric Diode and Photovoltaic Effect in BiFeO3
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent monodomain single-crystal study compares steady zero-bias photocurrent under green and red illumination.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Ferroelectric monodomain BiFeO3 single crystal with lateral silver electrodes
source_candidates.method_scope: Steady zero-bias photocurrent under side-selective green and red illumination with polarization-direction checks
source_candidates.reported_lead: Steady photocurrent density is about 7.35 microamperes per square centimetre under green light and 2.6 nanoamperes per square centimetre under red light.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The reported zero-bias photocurrent is wavelength- and illumination-geometry-bound and is not a standard one-sun solar-cell Jsc.

source_candidates.title: Role of domain walls in the abnormal photovoltaic effect in BiFeO3
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent domain-wall geometry and temperature study tests the earlier wall-step interpretation and reports much larger above-bandgap voltage.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Epitaxial BiFeO3 films with 71 and 109 degree periodic stripe domains and controlled electrode-to-wall geometry
source_candidates.method_scope: Illuminated current-voltage measurements across temperature, gap width and parallel or perpendicular domain-wall configurations
source_candidates.reported_lead: Open-circuit voltage reaches up to about 50 V, while the paper emphasizes geometry, conductivity and bulk-photovoltaic interpretation.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The maximum is an anomalous lateral-geometry result and cannot be compared directly with sub-volt vertical capacitors by voltage alone.

questions.comparison_question_zh: BFO 沉积速率能否跨 PLD、MOCVD 与磁控溅射路线直接迁移？

source_candidates.title: Ca Solubility in a BiFeO3-Based System with a Secondary Bi2O3 Phase on a Nanoscale
source_candidates.independence_note: Open primary PLD study reports both deposition time, thickness and the resulting rate for its pure BFO control.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Pure BiFeO3 control film on 001 SrTiO3 deposited at 700 degrees Celsius and 3 Pa oxygen
source_candidates.method_scope: KrF pulsed laser deposition at 5 Hz and 300 mJ pulse energy with ten-minute growth
source_candidates.reported_lead: A 48 nm pure BFO film after ten minutes is reported as a growth rate of 0.80 angstrom per second.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The rate is bound to laser fluence, repetition, target distance, pressure and chamber calibration.

source_candidates.title: Piezoelectric BiFeO3 Thin Films: Optimization of MOCVD Process on Si
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent MOCVD optimization varies carrier flow and directly reports the associated growth-rate range.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Polycrystalline BiFeO3 films grown on silicon-based IrO2 electrode stacks
source_candidates.method_scope: Metal-organic chemical vapour deposition with gas-flow comparison and cross-sectional thickness measurement
source_candidates.reported_lead: Average growth rate decreases from 9 to 4 nanometres per minute when the carrier-flow condition is increased.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: A gas-flow-dependent MOCVD interval is not equivalent to a PLD pulse-normalized rate.

source_candidates.title: Electric and Magnetic Properties of Sputter Deposited BiFeO3 Films
source_candidates.independence_note: Independent room-temperature magnetron-sputtering route gives a far slower nominal rate and requires post-growth heat treatment.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Twenty nanometre polycrystalline BFO films deposited at room temperature and subsequently heat treated
source_candidates.method_scope: Magnetron sputtering at five millitorr argon and six-inch target distance
source_candidates.reported_lead: The reported sputter deposition rate is 0.03 nanometres per minute.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The slow sputter rate and post-anneal route are a method boundary, not evidence that faster PLD or MOCVD values are wrong.

questions.comparison_question_zh: 公开 BFO 原始论文是否明确报告独立制备批次数，而不是只展示同一批样品内的厚度或条件序列？

source_candidates.title: Epitaxial BiFeO3 Multiferroic Thin Film Heterostructures
source_candidates.independence_note: The public main article was screened specifically for explicit independent synthesis replication rather than sample-series count.
source_candidates.method_scope: Bounded main-article reporting audit for independent growth batches
source_candidates.reported_lead: No explicit independent synthesis batch count was located in the screened main article.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Absence in a bounded main-article screen does not prove that one batch was used or that supplementary laboratory records do not exist.

source_candidates.title: Switchable ferroelectric diode and photovoltaic effects in polycrystalline BiFeO3 thin films grown on transparent substrates
source_candidates.independence_note: An independent full article was screened for a separately prepared batch count and not merely repeated electrical sweeps.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Polycrystalline Au slash BiFeO3 slash ITO photovoltaic specimens
source_candidates.method_scope: Full-article reporting audit for independently repeated film-growth batches
source_candidates.reported_lead: No explicit number of independently repeated film-growth batches was located in the screened article.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: Repeated poling states and current-voltage curves are not independent synthesis batches and cannot be counted as such.

source_candidates.title: Frequency-dependent decoupling of domain-wall motion and lattice strain in bismuth ferrite
source_candidates.independence_note: The open primary article explicitly states a batch count and total specimen count, providing a positive reporting example independent of the thin-film routes.
source_candidates.sample_scope: Polycrystalline BFO ceramics; three batches and seventeen total specimens; batches sintered at 745, 760 and 780 degrees Celsius
source_candidates.method_scope: Solid-state reactive sintering followed by frequency-resolved in-situ high-energy X-ray diffraction under sub-coercive electric-field cycling
source_candidates.reported_lead: Three batches comprising 17 total specimens are explicitly reported.
source_candidates.claim_boundary: The batches correspond to distinct sintering temperatures, so the count demonstrates explicit batch reporting but not three independent repeats under one identical preparation condition.
